description: The people of the results archive (1968 to 2022): hand, date of birth, country, height, and career-high rank with the week it was first reached. Their ids are corpus person ids (the winner/loser player_id on archive results), not roster ids. For current players use search_players. Requires the BASIC plan or any History plan.

query.description: Full or partial player name, min 3 chars, e.g. "navratilova".

name: search_archive_players

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

players.description: Matching archive people, ordered by name.

career_high_date.description: The earliest week the career-high rank was reached.

career_high_rank.description: Career-high rank, from the corpus's own weekly tables.

id.description: Corpus person id, the id archive match rows carry as winner/loser player_id. NOT a roster id.

title: Archive player bios
